Cross-ref (analyst): https://uk.finance.yahoo.com/news/ftse-100-live-blue-chips-061600767.html
(ONS official bulletin + Yahoo/ING commentary)
UK CPI slowed to 2.6% in the year to June 2026, down from 2.8% in May, below the 2.7% expected. Core CPI held at 2.6%; services inflation eased to 3.6% from 3.7%. Food inflation fell to 1.7%.
Bank of England Monetary Policy Committee decision due 30 July 2026; a hold is widely expected. James Smith (ING) expects rates held through 2026 before gradual cuts from spring 2027. The Ofgem energy price cap rose 13% on 1 July, and Brent has rebounded past $95, so forecasters expect headline inflation to climb back towards 3.4% by November.
